# Contributing

Thanks for helping improve OnCallAlert.

This repository hosts the issue tracker, docs and public Android builds. The source code is not developed here, so **pull requests are not accepted**.

The best way to contribute is to [open an issue](https://github.com/OnCallAlert/oncallalert/issues/new/choose):

- **Bug report**: something does not work as expected.
- **Feature request**: an idea or improvement.
- **Question / support**: help with installing, configuring or using OnCallAlert.

Before opening an issue, search the [existing issues](https://github.com/OnCallAlert/oncallalert/issues) to avoid duplicates.
Remove secrets (API keys, tokens, phone numbers) from anything you paste.

Security problems must not be reported as public issues. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
